tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: paper in the light theme, ink in the dark.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and panels that sit on the ground. Edge them with a rule, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ground-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, wells and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card edges. Decorative: never the only sign that a control is there.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and a card edge on hover. At least 3:1 on ground and ground-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mark, on ground, ground-raised, ground-sunken and blueline-wash (14:1 or more). Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, captions, body text inside cards. On every ground, 9:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Metadata, placeholders and quiet labels. On every ground, 4.7:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill, such as the primary button label.

tokens.name: blueline
tokens.usage: Construction lines only: grids, guides, dimension lines, overshoot zones. Non-photo blue, the drafter's pencil the camera ignores. Never text, never a fill behind text, never the only cue.

tokens.name: blueline-ink
tokens.usage: Annotation text in the construction layer (dimensions, specs) and the focus ring. On ground, ground-raised, ground-sunken and blueline-wash: 5.3:1 or more light, 10:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: blueline-wash
tokens.usage: Text selection and the tint of a measured area. ink and blueline-ink stay legible on it.

tokens.name: redline
tokens.usage: Errors, and the crossed-out examples in this book. Never decoration. 4.6:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour; drawn by the focus-ring shadow token.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links stay ink and are underlined; colour never marks a link on its own.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The mark's ink, fixed in both themes. For artwork that must stay black: print, the ink-ground avatar, business card fronts.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The mark's paper, fixed in both themes. The mark on brand-ink, and paper-ground artwork.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Non-photo blue, fixed in both themes. Construction drawings on fixed artwork. Text on it is brand-ink (13:1).

families.sans: Jost, "Futura PT", Futura, "Century Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Jost Medium. One display size per view; the largest thing on the page is never louder than the mark.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines and covers. At most once per page.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: The mark is built like a letter

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings inside a section; project card titles at 2 columns or wider.

styles.name: subheading
styles.sample: Flat edges sit on the line
styles.usage: Small headings, card titles on phones.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Jost Regular (400). Jost's x-height is low (0.46 em), so body text starts at 18px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I design things and then build them, and I like both halves to make sense.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Curves and points overshoot the lines, so all three shapes look the same height.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, nav items. Always set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase), the way the wordmark is.

groups.name: Depth
groups.note: DM Mono. The voice of the construction layer: numbers, specs, code. Never for prose.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Specs and data in layouts: dimensions, years, versions.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Labels on construction lines, in blueline-ink.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Steps grow by roughly 1.5x so neighbouring steps stay easy to tell apart.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; an annotation's offset from its line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding; the phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; the tablet page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones; the desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room. Rare.

radius.note: Two corners, after the two shapes that have them: the square's and the circle's. Nothing in between.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: buttons, inputs, cards, images, tiles, slides.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only things that are circles: avatars, status dots, switch thumbs.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows: depth is drawn with a rule, not a blur. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the ground colour, then 2px of solid blueline-ink (5.8:1 light, 13:1 dark). Follows radius-square.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, card edges, construction lines, underlines.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Hover underline, the focus ring, an active tab's underline.

markSize.note: Side of the mark's square, in px. Everything else in the mark scales from it.

tokens.name: mark-xs
tokens.usage: The smallest the row mark goes on screen; the 60-unit gap is then one pixel. Smaller than this, use the wrapped micro mark.

tokens.name: mark-sm
tokens.usage: Nav bars and the inline lockup in a header.

tokens.name: mark-md
tokens.usage: Footers, cards, email signatures.

tokens.name: mark-lg
tokens.usage: Heroes, covers, title slides.

tokens.name: duration-tick
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-step
tokens.usage: Menus, panels, the construction layer fading in.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: The mark resolving from blur. Once per page load, never on scroll.

easing.note: Arrivals settle with the circle's overshoot.

tokens.name: easing-settle
tokens.usage: Things arriving. Peaks 3.1% past the target, the same overshoot that makes the circle look as tall as the square.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Things moving within the page.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.
